+"""Loads the versioned completeness-criteria config (spec section 8.2)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import yaml
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+
+
+class CompletenessCriteria(BaseModel):
+    criteria_version: str
+    name: str
+    raw: dict
+
+
+def load_criteria(path: Path) -> CompletenessCriteria:
+    data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    return CompletenessCriteria(
+        criteria_version=data["criteria_version"], name=data["name"], raw=data
+    )

+"""Section identification per the config's detection strategy (R5)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+SECTION_KEYS = ("S", "O", "A", "P")
+
+
+def identify_sections(note_text: str, detection: dict) -> dict[str, int | None]:
+    """Return the start offset of each SOAP section, or None when unidentifiable."""
+    starts: dict[str, int | None] = {}
+    for key in SECTION_KEYS:
+        starts[key] = _find_marker(note_text, detection["header_markers"][key])
+    if any(start is None for start in starts.values()):
+        starts = _fallback_scan(note_text, detection, starts)
+    return starts
+
+
+def _find_marker(note_text: str, markers: list[str]) -> int | None:
+    lowered = note_text.lower()
+    best = None
+    for marker in markers:
+        at = lowered.find(marker.lower())
+        if at != -1 and (best is None or at < best):
+            best = at
+    return best
+
+
+def _fallback_scan(note_text: str, detection: dict, starts: dict) -> dict:
+    # Documented fallback heuristic, versioned in the config file itself.
+    raise NotImplementedError("fallback path is specified in criteria-v1.yaml")

+"""Criteria evaluation: findings with pinned evidence-span semantics (R3)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from app.sections import identify_sections
+
+
+def evaluate(note_text: str, criteria: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    """Evaluate every criterion; spans index the raw note_text, end-exclusive."""
+    findings = []
+    sections = identify_sections(note_text, criteria["section_detection"])
+    for criterion in criteria["criteria"]:
+        status, evidence = _check(criterion, sections, note_text)
+        findings.append(
+            {
+                "criterion_id": criterion["id"],
+                "section": criterion["section"],
+                "status": status,
+                "evidence": evidence,
+                "message": "",
+            }
+        )
+    return findings
+
+
+def _check(criterion: dict, sections: dict, note_text: str) -> tuple[str, list[dict]]:
+    start = sections.get(criterion["section"]) if criterion["section"] else None
+    if start is None:
+        return "missing", []
+    return "present", [{"start": start, "end": start + 1, "text": note_text[start : start + 1]}]
